mappings.assertion: TestRecoverTask_AbsentTaskRefusesRequestBinding (absent-task request ID refusal leaves the worktree and branch); TestRecoverTask_PreserveRefusalPreparationFence (a preserve refusal without attach retires its preparation, after an attach attempt the fence stays); with recover_task_test.go TestRecoverTask_PreserveRejectsClaimDriftBeforeRelease (drift at beforePreserveModify refuses) and ownership_lifecycle_test.go TestOwnershipLifecycleRecoveryRetiresPreparationAndReplays (replay returns without effects). Negative proof: dropping the preparation retirement failed the 'no attach' case and was restored.

TestRecoverTaskFresh_PreflightFailureReturnsBeforeCleanup (E1 failure: no cleanup, worktree, branch, task and agent unchanged) and TestRecoverTaskFresh_CompletionErrorAfterEffectsAbortsCallback (a completion-request error after E1-E3 aborts the callback: task, agent and notes unpublished); retained in recover_task_test.go: TestRecoverTaskFresh_RejectsStateDriftBeforeGitCleanup, ..._CleanupFailureLeavesStateAndArtifactsUnchanged, ..._CreateFailureAfterCleanupBlocksWithTruthfulState and ..._ReviewingTaskResetsInitialAndClearsReviewMetadata (success releases the snapshot agents and completes the receipt). Negative proof: removing the E1 preflight failed the preflight test and was restored.

TestRecoverAgent_ClaimSetChangedBeforeRecovery (requery/none), TestRecoverAgent_RegistrationReplacedBeforePreparation (stale caller/none, claim retained, no preparation), TestRecoverAgent_RegistrationReplacedBetweenGitRemovalAndCompletion (stale caller/unknown, claim and replacement registration retained), TestRecoverAgent_FailedReleasePreservesAgentWithWarning (agent preserved with its warning). Negative proofs: removing each of the claim-set equality and the two generation rechecks failed the named test and was restored.

TestReleaseClaim_BothClaims (reviewer then doer effects and projection), TestRejectedTaskHandoff and TestReleaseRejectedClaim (rejected-handoff candidate validation), TestReleaseClaim_NoClaims and the retained Pipeline* reviewer/doer release suites run unchanged against the extracted descriptor and transaction; the reviewer branch is also frozen by the oracle goldens release-claim/reviewer-release and recover-agent/reviewer-release.

TestHandoff_ReplayAndRefusalPublishNothing (receipt replay and the already-pending refusal leave state.yaml byte-identical); handoff_test.go TestHandoff_Validation, _Success, _WrongStatus, _WrongAgent and TestHandoffPreflight (payload validation before any blackboard read) run unchanged.

TestTransitionToNewAttempt_SentinelReplacedSkipsCleanup (a sentinel replaced between phases refuses finalisation, skips cleanup and keeps the worktree and evidence); retained: transition_attempt_contention_test.go TestAttemptFinalizationTimeoutPreservesReviewedGitEvidence and transition_attempt_test.go TestTransitionToNewAttempt_WorktreeDeletionFailure (cleanup failure only warns after committed state), _ReviewerNotReleasedOnPhase3Failure. Negative proof: disabling the sentinel recheck failed the new test and was restored.

TestOracleRecoverTaskFresh, TestOracleRecoverTaskAbsent, TestOracleAttemptRollover and TestOracleReleaseReviewer compare json, human and state.yaml/git effects against goldens written from the starting tree; every earlier A3 lifecycle golden (TestOracleRecoverTask, TestOracleRecoverAgent, TestOracleReleaseClaim, TestOracleHandoff, TestOracleClaimTaskVariants) is unchanged and passes after the refactor.

The nine goldens of the four new drivers (fresh-success, fresh-refusal-live-assignee, fresh-blocked, absent-force, absent-refusal, rollover-attempt-one, rollover-refusal-attempt-two, release-claim and recover-agent reviewer-release) were written by regen -mode write-new from the starting tree in commit 'test(oracle): pin A3 fresh recovery, absent-task, rollover and reviewer release' before any production edit; regen -mode check reproduces them and every earlier golden after the refactor.

Phase-aware interleavings under go test -race ./internal/ops/: generation replaced before preparation and between Git removal and completion (TestRecoverAgent_RegistrationReplaced*), sentinel replaced between rollover phases (TestTransition..._SentinelReplacedSkipsCleanup), snapshot drift at beforeFreshModify and beforePreserveModify (recover_task_test.go).

TestS1SizeGuard runs under make lint with area_a3_test.go no longer listing handoff.go:Handoff, recover_agent.go:recoverAgentLifecycle, recover_task.go (file), recover_task.go:recoverTaskWithOptions, release_claim.go:releaseClaimLocked or transition_attempt.go:transitionToNewAttemptLocked; the six declarations remain at their names and files, the new helpers and files meet S1, and mode_change.go:resume is untouched.
test target (go test ./...) runs the A3 oracle, ops and testguard suites; lint, test-e2e, the race run and the regen check are mandatory with it.
